    customers.validate_customer(None, 'john@example.com', 'us')
    print('✗ None name was accepted (should have raised ValueError)')
    sys.exit(1)
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'✓ None name rejected with: {e}')

print('All validations passed!')
"
